markers.title: Unallocated-reservations toggle has no label
markers.body: The full-width alert row ("1 unallocated reservation") ends in a toggle switch with no adjacent text explaining what it turns on or off. Add an explicit label (e.g. "Show only unallocated") next to the switch.

markers.title: Day-nav arrows too narrow
markers.body: The '‹' and '›' controls flanking the day strip are 32dp wide — under the 44dp HIG minimum on the horizontal axis (height is fine at 54dp). Widen the tappable area.

markers.title: Header action icons under 44dp
markers.body: The cleaning-mode, filter, and calendar icons in the top-right cluster are each 36×36dp — 8dp short of the tap target minimum on both axes.

markers.title: Identical placeholder photo for every reservation
markers.body: Alice Foster, Yasmin Ellis, and Fiona King all show the exact same generic train-track thumbnail. If this is meant to represent the guest or room, it currently carries no real information and could mislead staff into thinking it's meaningful.

working_well: Reservation cards use a clear, repeated layout (badge, name, dates, room) that makes scanning the list fast.
Status badges (CONFIRMED, CHECKED IN, UNALLOCATED) pair colour with a text label, so state isn't colour-only.
Cards with a payment problem get both a red border and explicit "Payment request expired" text — a strong, non-colour-only warning pattern.
The active day (FRI 31) is highlighted with both colour and an underline, giving a non-colour cue for the current selection.
worth_considering: Consider bumping the CONFIRMED/CHECKED IN badge text size slightly — at ~13dp it's on the small side for a key status indicator.
Long party names like "The Rodriguez Family" currently fit; worth testing longer names for graceful wrapping.
Group section headers (Check-ins, Check-outs, Stay-throughs) could show live counts to help staff prioritise without opening each tab.
